about: Built-in World Bible entries for Suxyland (places, factions, lore). Seeded into every browser like party.json; bump an entry's version to push changes. Link to another built-in entry with Name. An optional "pin" adds a linked pin to the bundled Suxyland map (x, y in Azgaar map units).

entries.title: Parniatus
entries.overview: A large, circular city built on top of The Wall, the mile-high wall that divides The Wastes from the rest of the mainland. It stands on the Wall's northwestern stretch, a full mile above the ground on either side.

entries.title: The Wastes
entries.overview: The Western Wastes: the far western reaches of Suxyland's western continent, cut off from the rest of the mainland by The Wall. The city of Parniatus sits on top of the Wall's northwestern stretch.

entries.title: The Wall
entries.overview:
A sheer wall a mile high that runs north to south across Suxyland's western continent, dividing The Wastes from the rest of the mainland.

The great circular city of Parniatus is built on top of its northwestern stretch.
